title: Machine-learning cfDNA methylation blood test for colorectal cancer screening in a high-risk population
summary: ColonSecure combines 149 hypermethylated cfDNA markers, chosen with Boruta feature selection, in a classifier trained on 196 CRC patients and 200 controls. It detected 89 of 103 colonoscopy-confirmed cancers (sensitivity 86.4%, AUROC 0.956), above CEA, CRP and CA19-9 (45.6%, 39.8%, 25.2%), in a prospective cohort of 3493 high-risk individuals. This is a letter in a single-region high-risk population, and whether the final model was frozen before the prospective cohort is not stated.
ai_technology: Boruta feature selection and machine-learning classifiers (glmnet, RF, SVM, XGBoost) on cfDNA methylation
organization: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College; Cancer Hospital of Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

evidence.tested: Held-out test set and a prospective cohort of 3493 high-risk individuals.
evidence.unknown: Final model type and its freezing before the prospective cohort.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning selected markers and built the classifier.
